ITF (1991,92)

This one appeared in March 1991 on a Sydney University FTP server
(physics.su.oz.au), but was (according to the revision headers) actually
written in June 1987. It supported Z-code V3 only; the version number was
either 1.0 or 2.0.

The elusive authors (David Beazley, George Janczuk, Peter Lisle, Russell
Hoare, Chris Tham) kept their names and e-mail addresses secret and called
themselves the InfoTaskForce (ITF). According to legend they started
working on the interpreter in early 1987 when they were undergrads at
Sydney University.

The ITF disappeared after the interpreter's release but came back in
September 1992 and published the second release (4.01). It supported V1-4
(and partial V5, lacking timeouts and graphics) and has been widely ported
since. Shortly thereafter the ITF disappeared (again).
